diagnosis.title: SeedAI diagnosis
diagnosis.note: Provisional analysis for this conversation. Hypotheses and recommendations are not confirmed facts.
diagnosis.insufficient: There is not enough evidence to identify the bottleneck yet.
strategy.reviewNote: This draft uses the conversation diagnosis. Review hypotheses and complete execution details, owner, deadline, metric and target before starting. Empty optional fields remain unspecified. It will be saved as a draft.
strategy.name: Name
strategy.title: What to do
strategy.pageNote: Permanent plans for the active company. Completing an action does not prove results: review the metrics.
strategy.empty: No saved strategies. Use Turn into a SeedAI strategy after a diagnosis in the conversation.
strategy.invalid: Check required fields, lengths and dates.
strategy.error: Could not save or load the strategy. Check your session and try again.
strategy.conflict: The record changed or this submission was saved with different data. Refresh before continuing.
decision.pageNote: Record what you decided and why. Return later to compare expectations with results.
decision.note: Confirm the decision you made. Conversation context is only a starting point; recommendations are not executed decisions. Hypothesis, baseline and review date may be left blank.
decision.reviewNote: Compare with the baseline. Describe observations and learning, including inconclusive results. This review replaces the previous one; the original decision is preserved.
decision.empty: No decisions recorded for this company.
decision.invalid: Check required fields and dates. The planned review cannot precede the decision.
decision.error: Could not save or load the decision. Check your session and try again.
decision.conflict: This record changed. Refresh before continuing.
experiment.pageNote: Test a hypothesis, record the result and turn experience into learning.
experiment.note: Review the hypothesis and define a measurable action. Baseline, target and result use the same metric, unit and period. The plan only starts when you click Start. Review before saving: plan details cannot be edited afterward.
experiment.name: Name
experiment.numberHint: Use numbers without symbols or thousands separators and a decimal point (e.g. 12.5), up to 9 integer digits and 6 decimals.
experiment.finishNote: Compare baseline, target and result. The outcome is your assessment, not statistical proof. Only inconclusive outcomes may omit the result; explain in learning. Finishing closes the record.
experiment.invalid: Check fields, numbers and dates. Validation or invalidation requires a result; learning is always required.
experiment.error: Could not save or load the experiment. Check your session and try again.
experiment.conflict: The experiment changed or this transition is not allowed. Refresh the page.
